==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Huo'wen:''' You have a strong sensitivity to the angle of shooting, but you are not careful enough in your actions...
:{{DIcon}} Who are you talking about?
:'''Huo'wen:''' Oh, I'm talking about my junior, [[Qingling]]. She has been helping me with the shooting recently and has submitted a lot of good materials.
:'''Huo'wen:''' As a war reporter, her daring and adventurous personality has helped her excel in her missions, which is quite impressive. I can even see my younger self in her.
:'''Huo'wen:''' However, the [[Tacet Discord]] is rampant here, and the ferocious Tacet Discord can appear from anywhere. The shallow waters beneath your feet are unstable, and the ruins are filled with precarious dangers...
:'''Huo'wen:''' Even walking can easily lead to encounters with long-abandoned dangerous weapons.
:'''Huo'wen:''' In such a dangerous environment, her fearless determination worries me a lot.
:'''Huo'wen:''' I have advised her countless times, but she never listens. If you see her, please help me persuade her.
:'''Huo'wen:''' Based on my past adventure experiences, it's better to be cautious in your actions here.
{{Dialogue End}}
